arxiv-2111-03658.title: Algebraic Analysis of Electric Load and Electricity Pricing
arxiv-2111-03658.creator: Jinghuan Ma, Jie Gu, Zhijian Jin
arxiv-2111-03658.description: Abstract This paper presents a perspective of functional analysis to analyze electric load and electricity pricing in the L 2 L_{2} space and its isomorphic vector space, which also yields the general algebraic model of load and pricing associated with time course.

arxiv-2202-03640.title: Designing exceptional-point-based graphs yielding topologically guaranteed quantum search
arxiv-2202-03640.creator: Quancheng Liu, David A. Kessler, Eli Barkai
arxiv-2202-03640.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Quancheng Liu, David A. Kessler, Eli Barkai. Quantum walks underlie an important class of quantum computing algorithms, and represent promising approaches in various simulations and practical applications. Here we design stroboscopically monitored quantum walks and their subsequent graphs that can naturally boost target searches.

arxiv-2304-11792.title: Mixed radial-angular bounds for Hardy-type operators on Heisenberg groups 0 0 footnotetext: Key words and phrases : Hardy operator; dual operator; weighted Hardy operator; weighted Cesàro operator; mixed radial-angular space; Heisenberg group. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification : Primary 42B25;
arxiv-2304-11792.creator: Zhongci Hang, Xiang Li, Dunyan Yan
arxiv-2304-11792.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper, we will study n -dimensional Hardy operator and its dual in mixed radial-angular spaces on Heisenberg groups and obtain their sharp bounds by using the rotation method. Furthermore, the sharp bounds of n -dimensional weighted Hardy operator and weighted Cesàro operator are also obtained.

arxiv-2503-02308.title: Cross, Dwell, or Pinch: Designing and Evaluating Around-Device Selection Methods for Unmodified Smartwatches Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’25), April 26-May 1, 2025, Y
arxiv-2503-02308.creator: Jiwan Kim, Jiwan Son, Ian Oakley
arxiv-2503-02308.description: Abstract . Smartwatches offer powerful features, but their small touchscreens limit the expressiveness of the input that can be achieved. To address this issue, we present, and open-source, the first sonar-based around-device input on an unmodified consumer smartwatch. We achieve this using a fine-grained, one-dimensional sonar-based finger-tracking system.

arxiv-2506-14131.title: Positive Sharing and Abstract Machines
arxiv-2506-14131.creator: Beniamino Accattoli, Claudio Sacerdoti Coen, Jui-Hsuan Wu
arxiv-2506-14131.description: Abstract Wu’s positive λ \lambda -calculus is a recent call-by-value λ \lambda -calculus with sharing coming from Miller and Wu’s study of the proof-theoretical concept of focalization. Accattoli and Wu showed that it simplifies a technical aspect of the study of sharing; namely it rules out the recurrent issue of renaming chains, that often causes a quadratic time slowdown.

arxiv-2507-19461.title: Existence of 2-EFX Allocations of Chores Thanks: This work was supported by NSF Grant CCF-2334461.
arxiv-2507-19461.creator: Jugal Garg, Aniket Murhekar
arxiv-2507-19461.description: Abstract We study the fair division of indivisible chores among agents with additive disutility functions. We investigate the existence of allocations satisfying the popular fairness notion of envy-freeness up to any chore (EFX), and its multiplicative approximations. The existence of 4 4 -EFX allocations was recently established in [ 30 ] .

pmc-11547570.title: Effect of Nicotinamide Riboside Against the Exhaustion of CD8+ T Cells via Alleviating Mitochondrial Dysfunction
pmc-11547570.creator: Ying Xiao, Nengzhi Pang, Sixi Ma, Mengqi Gao, Lili Yang, Maria Concetta Scuto
pmc-11547570.description: Background: Targeting mitochondria and protecting the mitochondrial function of CD8+ T cells are crucial for enhancing the clinical efficacy of cancer immunotherapy. Objectives: In this study, our objective was to investigate the potential of nicotinamide riboside (NR) in preserving the mitochondrial function of CD8+ T cells and mitigating their exhaustion.

pmc-11608556.title: Radiofrequency Ablation: Honoring the Pioneers of Modern Therapeutic Innovations
pmc-11608556.creator: Vladislav P Zhitny, Ryan Jannoud, Jake P Young, Brett Dixon, Brittani Bungart, Leroy Phillips, Kenneth Sutin, Jeffrey Bernstein, Mohammed Issa
pmc-11608556.description: Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) is a minimally invasive technique used to alleviate chronic pain by destroying pain-signaling nerve fibers. This procedure offers precise and focused pain relief, serving as an alternative to surgical and pharmacological treatments for chronic conditions such as arthritis, back pain, neck pain, and nerve pain.

pmc-11644567.title: Silk Fibroin Seed Coatings: Towards Sustainable Seed Protection and Enhanced Growth
pmc-11644567.creator: Feng Jin, Zhengrong Guan, Jiahao Zhang, Zhigang Qu, Shengjie Ling, Leitao Cao, Jing Ren, Ruoxuan Peng, Francisco Javier Espinach Orús
pmc-11644567.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Seed coating technology is vital in agriculture, enhancing seed protection and growth. However, conventional coatings often include chemical fungicides that pose environmental risks, highlighting the need for sustainable alternatives. This study explores silk fibroin (SF), a natural biopolymer with excellent film-forming properties, as a potential seed coating agent, addressing its antimicrobial limitations by combining it with the commercial agent CRUISER® and the antimicrobial peptide Nisin.

pmc-12038600.title: Acupuncture-assisted embryo transfer techniques: Research frontiers and future directions
pmc-12038600.creator: Rui-Yue Mao, Ai-Ling Wang, Yue Zhao, Shuai-Yan Wang, Zhen-Yu Yang, You-Bing Xia, Tian-Cheng Xu
pmc-12038600.description: BACKGROUNDAcupuncture, an ancient practice, is gaining recognition as a complementary and alternative medicine, especially in assisted reproductive technology. It plays a crucial role in enhancing embryo transfer success rates. Research indicates that acupuncture can improve blood flow, increase endometrial receptivity regulate pressure, and affect neuroendocrine activities in the ovaries and uterus during embryo implantation, therefore improving pregnancy outcomes.

pmc-12528505.title: Role of deformation twins in magnetic heterogeneity of MC 1100 and Barkhausen noise emission
pmc-12528505.creator: M. Neslušan, J. Veselý, R. Čep, P. Minárik, J. Čapek, M. Jacková
pmc-12528505.description: This paper deals with the surface heterogeneity in the near-surface region of the high strength low alloyed steel MC 1100. The remarkable surface thermal softening takes place due to decarburization during hot rolling, which in turn avoids very fine short twins within the grain interior during the accelerated cooling.

pmc-12538188.title: Long-lasting effects on cognition and mental health in patients with post COVID-19 condition following a mild SARS-CoV-2 infection: A longitudinal case–control study
pmc-12538188.creator: Goran Papenberg, Marika C Möller, Gabriela Markovic, Kristian Borg, Jonas Stenberg, Stina Hedström, Frida Smids, Emil Norrman, Andrea Aejmelaeus-Lindström, Grégoria Kalpouzos, Erika J Laukka
pmc-12538188.description: BackgroundThe prevalence of prolonged symptoms following a severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection represents a significant health challenge with potentially severe individual and societal costs. Our study investigates the long-term cognitive and mental health consequences associated with post-coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) condition (PCC) following a mild SARS-CoV-2 infection.

pmc-12665068.title: CRISPR/Cas9‐Mediated Knockouts of the ALG3 and GNTI in N. benthamiana and Their Application to Pharmaceutical Production
pmc-12665068.creator: Dolgormaa Bataa, Hiroyuki Kajiura, Reimi Lai Sang Sawada‐Choi, Yukino Yamashita, Takeshi Ishimizu, Ryo Misaki, Atsushi Takeda, Kazuhito Fujiyama
pmc-12665068.description: N‐Glycosylation critically influences the efficacy, safety and pharmacokinetic properties of biopharmaceuticals. Plant expression platforms offer multiple advantages for the production of N‐glycosylated proteins, but their use is impeded by the presence of plant‐specific N‐glycan epitopes, which raise concerns of possible immunogenicity to humans.

pmc-12691540.title: Histone Deacetylase Inhibition Enhances AQP3 Levels in Human Corneal Epithelial Cells and Corneal Wound Healing in Normoglycemic and Diabetic Male Mice
pmc-12691540.creator: Samuel Melnyk, Xiaowen Lu, Victoria Ronderos, Vivek Choudhary, Maribeth H Johnson, Mitchell A Watsky, Wendy B Bollag, Elia Ranzato
pmc-12691540.description: Highlights What are the main findings? SAHA improved corneal wound healing in diabetic and normoglycemic mice.AQP3 expression was increased at the wound’s edge in the cornea during healing. What is the implication of the main finding? SAHA could potentially be used clinically to promote corneal wound healing.AQP3 upregulation at the edge of corneal wounds is likely important for healing.

pmc-13001649.title: Wolbachia-induced cytoplasmic incompatibility triggers intergenerational dysregulation of the small RNA regulatory network in offspring
pmc-13001649.creator: Weihao Dou, Tianchu Li
pmc-13001649.description: The intracellular symbiont Wolbachia, which is widespread among insects, may induce cytoplasmic incompatibility (CI) between hosts with different infection statuses. Increasing evidence indicates that symbiotic bacteria can influence host reproduction, metabolism, and other biological processes by modulating non-coding small RNAs. However, it is still unclear how Wolbachia-induced CI affects the offspring reproduction.

pmc-13047935.title: Demyelinating Leprosy Neuropathy: An Unusual and Misleading Electrophysiological Pattern
pmc-13047935.creator: Cendrine Foucard, Marie Jachiet, Karine Viala, Thierry Maisonobe, Guillaume Fargeot
pmc-13047935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction/AimsPeripheral neuropathy, especially mononeuropathy multiplex, is a frequent manifestation of leprosy. Electrodiagnostic studies (EDX) usually show predominant axonal involvement. In this study, we report patients with prominent demyelinating abnormalities consistent with the diagnosis of chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (CIDP).MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed the medical records of patients with leprosy who underwent EDX at Pitié‐Salpêtrière University Hospital, Paris, France, between January 2014 and June 2022.
